nodes.title: Quick Intro
widgets_values:
- Input all keyframes as images. Default is 5, but you can adjust the number of inputs by bypassing or duplicating the Wan 2.2 FLF2V node groups

- Adjust width and height

- Adjust the length per keyframe pairs (17 is recommended minimum for legible motion)

- Adjust the "select_every_nth" to speed up the keyframes if the motion is faster than 17 frames
